newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African stocks end largely steady ahead of Xmas.
newsitem.headline: S.African stocks end largely steady ahead of Xmas.

text.p: 1210 GMT - South African shares ended largely stable on Christmas eve, with industrials easing slightly as players square positions. Gold shares were also softer on a steady bullion price.

Dealers said the features of the day were relatively large trades in De Beers and Anglo American but overall volumes were thin. The market was seen quiet on Friday after the two-day Christmas holiday.
The overall index up 9.5 points to 6,562.1, industrials lost 10.9 points to 7,783.5 and golds shed 5.6 points to 1,488.8.
